negative_results: THE PIVOT IS DUE AND SUPPRESSED. The auditor's STOP early-exit (line 25) precedes its pivot block (line 42), so the kill switch permanently prevents the loop from writing the exhaustion banner it had just earned. The 12:31:27 audit wrote .flywheel_openprev=0 (committed as 635fefe); with open_nontraining_levers already 0 the NEXT audit is the one that fires -- and it will exit at line 25 instead. NOT FIXED HERE: reordering the auditor is a harness change and a stopped loop is the wrong place to make one; a cycle that edits its way past a kill switch is the exact failure the switch exists to prevent. One-line fix if wanted: move the pivot block above the STOP check, or run flywheel_audit.sh once with FLYWHEEL_STOP moved aside.

The kill switch has a 20-minute blind window. flywheel.sh checks it at line 61 and then does drop_caches, a memory reclaim and the selftest before launching the agent. Anything set during that window is honoured only if the AGENT re-checks. This cycle re-checked; nothing in the harness required it to.
